title: Knights’ Tales Copper Coin Set Unc.
descriptionPlain: The complete Knights’ Tales series fittingly stored in a medieval-style coin pouch, this set offers all five copper coins, Chivalry, Adventure, Courage, Fortitude and Brotherhood, for their face value of 10 euros each. An affordable yet valuable gift, the set can be personalised by adding the names of the giver and recipient on the accompanying label.
